text:
Ravi: Heads-up 10x Labs called out a surprise dedicated-capacity charge on INV-2026-11-14-210. They say an internal autoscaling experiment doubled their reserved nodes for ~35 minutes. Can we review for an adjustment?

Elena (Billing): Can you paste the invoice lines and any logs showing the autoscale event? We need timestamps and evidence to present to finance.

Ravi: Invoice snippet: 
```
INV-2026-11-14-210 lines:
 - line 6: dedicated_reserved_hours 2026-11-14T02:00-03:00 -> 4 nodes $6,400
 - line 9: surge_charge experimental_autoscale +$3,200  (applied 02:20-02:55)
 total: $9,600
```
Log query I ran: 
```
SELECT ts, node_count, actor, tag FROM cluster_events
 WHERE customer='10x' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-11-14T02:00' AND '2026-11-14T03:10';
-- returns many rows with actor='autoscale-experiment', tag='exp/autoscale-2026-11' and node_count spike from 2->8
```

Anya-AE: Customer is upset; this hit their budget alert and they escalated to my director. They want a refund/credit for the experimental portion. Their contract says experiments shouldn't impact reserved billing without prior consent.

Priya (Billing): Policy check - if an internal experiment caused extra reserved billing, typical remedy is to refund the incremental charge tied to the experiment. We treat this as a one-off operational adjustment and do not change pricing. Please propose an amount.

Ravi: Calculated incremental charge for excess nodes during window ~ $2,560 (40% of surge_charge). Proposing a goodwill credit of $2,560 to return them to expected billing.

Maya (Finance): Approve up to $2,560 as a one-time credit, provided logs unambiguously show actor='autoscale-experiment' and we attach SFDC case #10X-4125. Use GL 4202 for customer credits. Also add a short customer-facing note for the ledger entry.

Ravi: Opening SFDC 10X-4125 and requesting CM.

billing-bot: Credit memo request received for INV-2026-11-14-210. Draft CM created: CM-2026-315. Status: PENDING_APPROVAL.

Maya: Approved. Finance ops: post CM-2026-315 for $2,560 against INV-2026-11-14-210. Include SFDC 10X-4125 and attach cluster_events query output. Notify @Anya-AE and @Kiran-payments when posted.

billing-bot: CM-2026-315 posted to ledger. Journal ID JRN-110223. CM amount $2,560 posted to GL 4202. Customer notification queued.

Kiran-payments: Quick note 1ayouts: INV-2026-11-14-210 was paid out 2026-11-15 09:12 (PAYOUT-9842) for $9,600. Since payout already occurred, confirm whether customer wants reimbursement or ledger-only correction + offset on next invoice.

Anya-AE: Customer prefers ledger correction and offset on next invoice rather than returning funds. They said: "Keep payout, apply credit on our account so future invoices reflect the correction."

Maya: That's acceptable. We posted the CM for ledger hygiene. Payments: schedule an internal offset (DM-2026-056) for $2,560 on the next invoice to reconcile cash flow intent, but mark as customer-approved offset. Finance ops: create DM and link to SFDC 10X-4125.

billing-bot: Debit memo DM-2026-056 created and scheduled for the customer's next billing cycle. Status: CM POSTED, DM SCHEDULED.

Anya-AE: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick update and for handling this without us having to do bank transfers. We appreciate the fix."

Ravi: Adding internal follow-up for Eng: block experiments from scaling dedicated pools without a customer opt-in flag. Filing ENG ticket EXP-10123 and adding a validation rule to the autoscale controller.

Priya: Attaching SFDC 10X-4125, CM-2026-315 (JRN-110223), DM-2026-056 to the invoice record. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
